topic: Deploying new reporting features to production
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered two main topics: data discrepancies and feature deployment. Initially, [p1] questioned a reduction in sessions after recalculation, specifically noting the issue was visible across individual facilities, particularly at 'realim'. The formula used for calculating session counts was reviewed.

Later, [p1] requested that a new reporting feature—'Average Number of Screen Seen (Cluster)'—be deployed to production environment for load testing. [me] confirmed ability to deploy this feature and also agreed to handle another ticket related to 'province'.
decisions: Deploy the 'Average Number of Screen Seen (Cluster)' reporting feature to production for load testing.
action_items: [me] to deploy the new Average Number of Screen Seen (Cluster) feature.
[me] to handle and deploy the ticket related to 'province'.
